title: Quasi-isomorphisms of complexes of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. A morphism $f:\mathcal F^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ of cochain complexes of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] is a *quasi-isomorphism* if the induced morphism of cohomology sheaves $H^i(f):H^i(\mathcal F^\bullet)\to H^i(\mathcal G^\bullet)$ [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules] is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O$-modules for every $i\in\mathbf Z$.
